en: Ezekiel 41

p.src: 1  He brought me to the nave and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side, which was the width of the tent.

en: He brought me to the nave and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side, which was the width of the tent.
u.src: 1  He brought me to the nave and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side, which was the width of the tent.

p.src: 2  The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.

en: The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.
u.src: 2  The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.

ja: 41:2 一キュビトは、人の腕の中指の先からひじまでの長さで、約18インチ、または46センチメートルである。
en: 41:2 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

p.src: 3  Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.

en: Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.
u.src: 3  Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.

p.src: 4  He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”

en: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”
u.src: 4  He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”

p.src: 5  Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.

ja: キュビト、宮を四方から
en: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.
u.src: 5  Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.

p.src: 6  The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.

ja: あり、上へ上へと重なっていた。宮の壁の
える段が設けられていたので、部屋の梁を宮の
en: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.
u.src: 6  The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.

p.src: 7  The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. Therefore the width of the house increased upward; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.

ja: くなっていた。宮を囲む壁が上の階ほど狭くなっていたからである。そのため、宮は
en: The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. Therefore the width of the house increased upward; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.
u.src: 7  The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. Therefore the width of the house increased upward; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.

p.src: 8  I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.

ja: くなった基壇があるのが
は、長キュビト六キュビト、すなわち一竿分であった。
en: I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.
u.src: 8  I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.

p.src: 9  The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.

ja: キュビトであった。宮に属する
の外側には空き地が残されていた。
en: The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.
u.src: 9  The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.

p.src: 10  Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.

en: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.
u.src: 10  Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.

p.src: 11  The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.

ja: された空き地に面しており、
きであった。周囲の空き地の
en: The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.
u.src: 11  The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.

p.src: 12  The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.

ja: キュビトであった。その
en: The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.
u.src: 12  The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.

p.src: 13  So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long;

ja: キュビトであった。別区画と、その
en: So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long;
u.src: 13  So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long;

p.src: 14  also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.

en: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.
u.src: 14  also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.

p.src: 15  He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits from the inner temple, and the porches of the court,

en: He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits from the inner temple, and the porches of the court,
u.src: 15  He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits from the inner temple, and the porches of the court,

p.src: 16  the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, opposite the threshold, with wood ceilings all around, and from the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),

ja: 、三階にわたって周囲にある回
は、敷居に面する所も含め、
われていた。木の覆いは地面から窓まで達し、窓にも覆いがあった。
en: the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, opposite the threshold, with wood ceilings all around, and from the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),
u.src: 16  the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, opposite the threshold, with wood ceilings all around, and from the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),

p.src: 17  to the space above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall all around inside and outside, by measure.

ja: から内側の宮まで、また
en: to the space above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall all around inside and outside, by measure.
u.src: 17  to the space above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall all around inside and outside, by measure.

p.src: 18  It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces,

ja: そこにはケルビムとなつめやしの
が彫られていた。ケルブとケルブの
en: It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces,
u.src: 18  It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces,

p.src: 19  so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. It was made like this through all the house all around.

ja: には、なつめやしの木に向いた
があり、もう一方には、なつめやしの
がこのように造られていた。
en: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. It was made like this through all the house all around.
u.src: 19  so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. It was made like this through all the house all around.

p.src: 20  Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this.

ja: まで、ケルビムとなつめやしの
はこのようになっていた。
en: Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this.
u.src: 20  Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this.

p.src: 21  The door posts of the nave were squared. As for the face of the nave, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.

en: The door posts of the nave were squared. As for the face of the nave, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.
u.src: 21  The door posts of the nave were squared. As for the face of the nave, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.

p.src: 22  The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that is before the LORD.”

ja: キュビトであった。その四隅、土台、側
en: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that is before the LORD.”
u.src: 22  The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that is before the LORD.”

p.src: 23  The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

en: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
u.src: 23  The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

p.src: 24  The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.

ja: それぞれの戸には、回転する戸板が
en: The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.
u.src: 24  The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.

p.src: 25  There were made on them, on the doors of the nave, cherubim and palm trees, like those made on the walls. There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.

ja: じケルビムとなつめやしの
en: There were made on them, on the doors of the nave, cherubim and palm trees, like those made on the walls. There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.
u.src: 25  There were made on them, on the doors of the nave, cherubim and palm trees, like those made on the walls. There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.

p.src: 26  There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch. This is how the side rooms of the temple and the thresholds were arranged.

ja: 部屋と敷居も、このように造られていた。
en: There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch. This is how the side rooms of the temple and the thresholds were arranged.
u.src: 26  There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch. This is how the side rooms of the temple and the thresholds were arranged.
